exposure: Receiving care at a rural primary maternity unit (PMU) without 24-h on-site surgical and anaesthetic capability
Midwifery group practice model of care
Maternal and neonatal transfers (to/from the unit)
cohort: All women (of all risk statuses) and their babies who booked to receive care through a midwifery group practice at a rural primary maternity unit in Queensland between 2009 and 2011.
finding: Clinical outcomes for women and babies receiving care at a rural primary maternity unit, including those transferred, were comparable to or better than published data, challenging the notion that rural birthing services require on-site surgical capability.
